purpose: Teach: 試乗/躍進/ビデオカメラ/刻印/副題/休職/借用/発令

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、新型パトカーの試乗を、警察、実施されますね
lines.en: So the police run test drives of the new patrol cars, don't they.
lines.style: Bright engaged opening, leaning in with interest. Polite even pace, rising confirmation-seeking lift at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、検挙率の躍進を、警察、目指されますね
lines.en: And they're aiming for a real leap in the arrest rate, aren't they.
lines.style: Warm admiration coloring the key phrase. Steady pace, a small impressed nod audible in the closing tag.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、現場のビデオカメラ証拠を、警察、解析されますね
lines.en: They analyze the video camera evidence from the scene as well.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact but attentive. Even pace, slight stress on the evidence, gentle rising tag at the finish.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、警察手帳に番号を刻印されますね
lines.en: Each police notebook even has its number engraved on it, doesn't it.
lines.style: Quieter, almost to himself, savoring the small detail. Slower on the engraving, soft appreciative finish.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、調書の副題、つまり項目見出しも整えられますね
lines.en: They even tidy up the subtitles in the reports — the section headings, that is.
lines.style: Light self-correcting clarification mid-line. Casual pace, a faint smile warming the tidy bureaucratic detail.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、長期療養の捜査員の休職対応もされますね
lines.en: They also handle leave arrangements for investigators on long-term medical recovery.
lines.style: Softer, more sober tone for the sensitive topic. Slower pace, respectful downward settle at the end.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、外部資料の借用記録を、警察、厳格に管理されますね
lines.en: And borrowing records for outside materials are managed strictly, aren't they.
lines.style: Crisper articulation on the strictness. Measured pace, quiet approval firming up the final syllables.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、緊急配備の発令を、警察、迅速にされますね
lines.en: And when an emergency deployment is ordered, they issue it fast.
lines.style: Firm admiring wrap-up. Slightly quicker pace mirroring the urgency, settling into a satisfied closing nod.
